title: Midbrain dopaminergic differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells
author: Tilo Kunath
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bddpi25n
materials: Prepare a 10 mM SB431542 solution.

To prepare 1190 µl of 10 mM SB431542: Add 1190 µL (2 x 595 µL ) of DMSO ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. D2650 ) directly to vial containing 5 mg of SB431542 ( Merck Millipore, cat no. 616461-5MG ) and mix by pipetting until powder is completely dissolved. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 10 mM SB431542 in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep SB431542 aliquot at Room temperature in the dark for up to two weeks.
Preparing reagents for mDA differentiation
Prepare 10 mM (100,000x) and 0.1 mM (1000x) stocks of LDN193189. C 25 H 22 N 6. MW: 406.48 g/mol.

To prepare 492 µl of 10 mM LDN193189: Add 492 µL of DMSO ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. D2650 ) directly to vial containing 2 mg of LDN193189 ( Miltenyi Biotec, cat no. 130-103-925 ) to obtain a 10 millimolar (mM) solution. Warm briefly (3-5min) at 37 °C to dissolve powder. Alternatively, LDN193189 can be obtained in solution at 10 mM in DMSO ( Miltenyi Biotec, cat no. 130-106-540 ). Dilute 10 mM LDN193189 at 1 in 100 with DMSO ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. D2650 ) to create 0.1 millimolar (mM) (1000x) stocks. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 0.1 mM LDN193189 in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep LDN193189 aliquot at Room temperature in the dark for up to two weeks.
Prepare 600 µg/ml (1000x) stock of Sonic Hedgehog (SHH-C24II).

To prepare 833 µl of 600 µg/ml SHH-C24II: Add volume of 822 µL of DPBS without Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 14190086 ) directly to vial containing 500 µg of SHH-C24II ( R+D Systems, cat no. 1845-SH-500 ). Add 11 µL of 7.5% BSA ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. A8412-100ML ) directly to the vial. Mix by pipetting up and down several times until the powder is dissolved. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 600 μg/ml SHH in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep SHH aliquot at for up to two weeks.
Prepare 10 mM stock of CHIR99021.

To prepare 2414 µl of 10mM CHIR99021: Add 2149 µL of DMSO ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. D2650 ) directly to vial containing 10 mg of CHIR99021 ( Miltenyi Biotech, Cat no 130-103-926 ) to obtain a 10 millimolar (mM) solution. Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. If precipitate is observed, warm briefly (2-5min) at 37 °C . Alternatively, CHIR99021 can be obtained in solution at 10 mM in DMSO ( Miltenyi Biotech, Cat no. 130-106-539 ) Prepare 10 µL aliquots of 10 mM CHIR99021 in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep CHIR99021 aliquot at Room temperature in the dark for up to two weeks.
Prepare 100 µg/ml (1000x) stock of recombinant FGF8b

To prepare 250 µl of 100 µg/ml FGF8b: Add 246 µL of DPBS without Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 14190086 ) directly to vial containing 25 µg of FGF8b ( R+D Systems, Cat no 423-F8-025 ) Add 3.4 µL of 7.5% BSA ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. A8412-100ML ) directly to the vial. Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 100 µg/ml FGF8b in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep FGF8b aliquots at in the dark for up to two weeks.
Prepare 1 mg/ml (1000x) stock of Heparin Sodium Salt from porcine intestinal mucosa

To prepare 55 ml of 1 mg/ml Heparin: Add 55 mL of DPBS without Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 14190086 ) directly to vial containing 55 mg of Heparin ( Sigma Aldrich, Cat no H3149 ). Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. Filter the reconstitued Heparin solution using an appropriatly sized syringe for the volume and 0.33µM filter Prepare 500 µL aliquots of 1 mg/ml Heparin in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at 4 °C for up to two years.
Prepare 20 µg/ml (1000x) stock of recombinant Bone-Derived Growth Factor (BDNF).

To prepare 5 ml of 20 µg/ml BDNF: Add 4930 µL of DPBS without Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 14190086 ) directly to vial containing 100 µg of BDNF ( PeproTech, Cat no 450-02 ). Add 70 µL of 7.5% BSA ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. A8412-100ML ) directly to the vial. Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 20 μg/ml BDNF in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep BDNF aliquots at for up to two weeks.
Prepare 20 µg/ml (2000x) stock of recombinant Glial Derived Growth Factor (GDNF).

To prepare 5 ml of 20 µg/ml GDNF: Add 4930 µL of DPBS without Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 14190086 ) directly to vial containing 100 µg of GDNF ( PeproTech, Cat no 450-10 ). Add 70 µL of 7.5% BSA ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. A8412-100ML ) directly to the vial. Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 20 μg/ml GDNF in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep GDNF aliquots at for up to two weeks.
Prepare 0.2 M (1000x) stock of Ascorbic Acid by Sigma Aldrich. C 6 H 8 O 6 , MW: 176.12 g/mol.

To prepare 2841 µl 0.2 M Ascorbic Acid: Add 2841 µL of sterile water directly to vial containing 100 mg of Ascorbic Acid ( Sigma Aldrich, Cat no A4403 ). Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. Filter the reconstitued Ascorbic Acid solution using an appropriatly sized syringe for the volume and a 0.33µM filter. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 0.2 Molarity (M) Ascorbic Acid in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep Ascorbic Acid aliquots at in the dark for up to two weeks.
Prepare 0.5 M (1000x) stock of dcAMP ( N 6 ,2′-O-Dibutyryladenosine 3′,5′-cyclic monophosphate sodium salt) by Sigma Aldrich. C 18 H 23 N 5 O 8 PNa, MW: 491.3 g/mol.

To prepare 4070 µl 0.5 M dcAMP: Add 4070 µL of sterile water directly to vial containing 1000 mg of dcAMP ( Sigma Aldrich, Cat no D0627 ). Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. Filter the reconstitued dcAMP solution using an appropriatly sized syringe for the volume and a 0.33µM filter. Prepare 20 µL - 50 µL aliquots of 0.5 Molarity (M) dcAMP in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep dcAMP aliquots at in the dark for up to two weeks.
Prepare 10 mM (10,000x) stock of DAPT C 23 H 26 F 2 N 2 O 4 , MW: 432.46 g/mol.

To prepare 2312 µl 10 mM DAPT: Add 2312 µL of DMSO ( Sigma Aldrich, cat no. D2650 ) directly to vial containing 10 mg of DAPT ( Tocris, Cat no 2634 ). Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. If precipitate is observed, warm the solution to 37 °C for 2-5 mins. Prepare 20 µL aliquots of 10 millimolar (mM) DAPT in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Once thawed, keep DAPT aliquots at in the dark for up to 1 month.
Prepare 10 mM (1000x) stock of Y-27632 dihydrochloride C 14 H 21 N 3 O.2HCl. MW: 320.26 g/mol.

To prepare 15.61 ml 10 mM Y-27632: Add 15.61 mL of DPBS without Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 14190086 ) directly to vial containing 50 mg of Y-27632 dihydrochloride ( Tocris, Cat no 1254 ). Mix by pipetting up and down several times to dissolve the powder. Prepare aliquots of 10 millimolar (mM) Y-27632 dihydrochloride in sterile 1.5-ml Eppendorfs tubes and store at -80 °C for up to one year. Prepare smaller 50 µL aliquots for working use and larger 500 µL aliquots which can be aliquoted out at a later date. Once thawed, keep Y-27632 aliquots at in the dark for up to 1 month.

Pre-Coating plates with Laminin 111: Laminin-111 stocks (0.1mg/ml) ( Biolamina, Cat no LN111 ) should be thawed at RT and then diluted 1:20 in DPBS (with Ca 2+ and Mg 2+ ) ( ThermoFischer, cat no. 14040083 ) to create a final working stock solution of 5 μg/ml Laminin-111. The diluted laminin should be mixed thoroughly and added to the wells at a volume recommended for the well size (see below table). Plate type Approx Area of Well (cm2) Volume of 5ug/ml L521 (ul) required for optimal coating 6 well 9.5 1200 12 well plate 4 600 24 well plate 2 300 48 well plate 1 150 96 well plate 0.33 50 Move the plate gently around to ensure the well is evenly covered Wrap the plate in parafilm to reduce evaporation Incubate the plate at 4 °C overnight for at least 12 hours (overnight incubation is recommended). Coated plates can be stored at 4 °C for 3 weeks.

To prepare 50ml of NIM: Add 24 mL of DMEM/F12 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 21331020 ) + 24 mL of Neurobasal TM Medium ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 21103049 ) + 500 µL of 100x N2 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 17502048 ) + 1 mL of 50x B27 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 17504044 ) + 500 µL of 200mM L-Glutamine ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 25030032 ).

Preparation of wash media for lifted hPSCs: Per each well of a 6 well plate of hPSCs prepare 4ml of wash media. Wash media: 50% iPS-Brew XF medium (self renewal media for hPSCs) + 50% DMEM/F12 + 10 μM Y27632. For example when lifting one well of hPSCs from a 6 well plate prepare: 2 mL iPS-Brew XF medium ( Miltenyibiotec, Cat no 130-104-368 ) + 2 mL DMEM/F12 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 21331020 ) + 2 µL 10mM Y27632.

Counting the cells: By using EDTA the cells are lifted as clumps. For more accurate counting of the cells take an aliquot to be broken into single cells. To count the cells, take 2 x 10 μl aliquots of cells into new 0.5ml Eppendorfs. Mix each with 10 µL of Trypan Blue ( Sigma Aldrich, Cat no T8154 ). Count the cells using a haemacytometer*. Calculate the amount of cells within the wash media.

Preparation of NPM 50% NIM + 25% Neurobasal + 25% DMEM/F12 + 2mM L-Glutamine. To prepare NPM from NIM: For example, to make 50 mL NPM = 25 mL NIM + 12.25 mL DMEM/F12 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 21331020 ) + 12.25 mL Neurobasal TM Medium ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 21103049 ) + 250 µL 200mM L-Glutamine ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 25030032 ). Altnatively to make NPM de novo: 50% Neurobasal, 50% DMEM/F12 + 0.5x N2 + 0.5x B27 + 2mM L-Glutamine. For example, to make 50 mL NPM = 24.4 mL of DMEM/F12 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 21331020 ) + 24.4 mL of Neurobasal TM Medium ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 21103049 ) + 250 µL of 100x N2 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 17502048 ) + 500 µL of 50x B27 ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 17504044 ) + 500 µL of 200mM L-Glutamine ( Thermo Fisher, Cat no 25030032 ).

steps.title: Prepare Base Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the following base media at the start of differentiation and store in the dark at 4 °C (or -4 °C for NIM) for up to 2 weeks:

substeps.instruction: Neural Induction Medium (NIM): 50% DMEM/F12 + 50% Neurobasal + 1x N2 + 1x B27 + 2mM L-Glutamine.
Neural Proliferation Media (NPM): Composed of N2 supplement, B27 supplement, DMEM/F12, and Neurobasal media.
Neural Differentiation Medium (NDM): Composed of B27 supplement and Neurobasal media.

steps.title: Coat Plates for Day 0
steps.instruction: Coat 24-well plates with Laminin-111 at least 12 hours prior to the beginning of differentiation.

steps.title: Prepare Day 0 Plating Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare plating medium consisting of NIM + 10 μM Y27632 + 10 μM SB431542 + 100nM LDN + 600 ng/ml Shh + CHIR99021 (concentration between 0.7 and 1.2 μM, depending on cell line).

substeps.instruction: Ensure a volume of 400 μl per well for 24-well plates.

steps.title: Lift and Seed hPSCs (Day 0)
steps.instruction: Lift hPSCs (grown on Laminin-521 5μg/ml in 6-well plates with 2 ml StemMACS iPS-BrewXF) and seed onto Laminin-111 plates.

substeps.instruction: Verify hPSC cultures are free of spontaneous differentiation and confluency is between 70% and 90%.
Aspirate iPS-Brew XF medium from the 6-well plate.
Wash cells once with 1 mL of 0.5 mM EDTA.
Add 1 mL of 0.5 mM EDTA and incubate at 37 °C for 5-7 minutes (or until cells appear refractile).
Remove EDTA and gently lift cells using 1 mL of Wash medium; transfer to a tube and invert to mix.
Calculate required cells for a density of 40,000 cells/cm² (e.g., 320,000 cells for 4 wells of a 24-well plate; note AST18 requires 60,000 cells/cm²).
Transfer 110% of the required cell volume to a new tube and centrifuge at 300 g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate wash media and resuspend colonies gently in the Day 0 plating medium (400 μl per well).
Aspirate Laminin-111 from the 24-well plates and seed the cell suspension, shaking to ensure even distribution.

steps.title: Day 2 Media Change
steps.instruction: Replace medium with fresh Day 2 medium: NIM + 10 μM SB431542 + 100nM LDN + 600 ng/ml SHH + CHIR99021 (0.6 to 1.0 μM).

substeps.instruction: Use 400 µL of fresh media per well of a 24-well plate.

steps.title: Day 4 Media Change
steps.instruction: Replace medium with fresh Day 4 medium: NPM + 10 μM SB431542 + 100nM LDN + 600 ng/ml Shh + CHIR99021 (0.6 to 1.0 μM).

substeps.instruction: Use 600 µL of fresh media per well of a 24-well plate.

steps.title: Day 7 Media Change
steps.instruction: Replace medium with fresh Day 7 medium: NPM + 10 μM SB431542 + 100 nM LDN + 600 ng/ml Shh + CHIR99021 (0.6 to 1.0 μM).

substeps.instruction: Use 600 µL of fresh media per well of a 24-well plate.

steps.title: Day 9 Media Change
steps.instruction: Replace medium with fresh Day 9 medium: NPM + 100 ng/ml FGF8b + 1 μM Heparin solution.

substeps.instruction: Use 600 µL of fresh media per well of a 24-well plate.

steps.title: Day 11 Replating
steps.instruction: Lift mDA Day 11 cells as single cells using Acctuase and replate onto new Laminin-111 coated plates at a density of 800,000 cells/cm².

substeps.instruction: Prepare wash medium: NPM + 10 μM Y27632 (1.2 mL per 24-well plate well).
Prepare plating medium: NDM + 10 μM Y-27632 + 20 ng/ml BDNF + 10 ng/ml GDNF + 100 ng/ml FGF8b + 0.2 mM Ascorbic Acid + 1 μg/ml heparin solution.
Centrifuge the required cell volume at 300 g for 3 minutes, aspirate wash media, and resuspend in plating medium (e.g., 600 μl per well for 4 wells).
Aspirate Laminin-111 from plates and seed the cell suspension, shaking for even distribution.
Alternative: Cryopreserve cells instead of replating.

steps.title: Day 14 Media Change
steps.instruction: Replace medium with fresh Day 14 medium: NDM + 20 ng/ml BDNF + 10 ng/ml GDNF + 100 ng/ml FGF8b + 0.2 mM Ascorbic Acid + 1 μg/ml heparin solution.

steps.title: Day 16 Replating
steps.instruction: Lift mDA Day 16 cells as single cells using Acctuase and replate onto new Laminin-111 coated plates at a density of 800,000 cells/cm².

substeps.instruction: Prepare wash media: NDM + 10 μM Y-27632 (1.2 mL per 24-well plate well or 0.6 mL per 48-well plate well).
Prepare plating medium: NDM + 10 μM Y27632 + 20 ng/ml BDNF + 10 ng/ml GDNF + 0.2 mM Ascorbic Acid + 0.5 mM dcAMP + 1 µM DAPT.
Centrifuge the required cell volume at 300 g for 3 minutes, aspirate wash media, and resuspend in plating medium (e.g., 600 μl per well for 4 wells).
Aspirate Laminin-111 from plates and seed the cell suspension with generous shaking.
Alternative: Cryopreserve or transplant cells into an animal model.

steps.title: Day 18 and Ongoing Maintenance
steps.instruction: From Day 18 to Day 45, feed cells every 2-3 days. After Day 45, feed once or twice a week.

substeps.instruction: Use medium: NDM + 20 ng/ml BDNF + 10 ng/ml GDNF + 0.2 mM ascorbic acid + 0.5 mM dcAMP + 1 µM DAPT.
Remove DAPT from the feeding medium after Day 45.
